title: Level 256 of Pac-Man Breaks the Game in Half

scenes.text: Level 256 of Pac-Man breaks the game in half.
Pac-Man came out in 1980 and it has no ending. It just breaks.
The game stores your level in one byte, and a byte can only count to 255.
Reach level 256 and the counter overflows back to zero.
The fruit routine goes haywire and fills the right half of the screen with garbage.
There aren't enough dots left to clear it. Pac-Man has no last level, just a glitch.

description:
Level 256 of Pac-Man breaks the game in half.
The level counter is stored in one 8-bit byte. At level 256 it overflows, the fruit-drawing routine runs wild, and the right half of the screen turns to garbage. The level needs 244 dots to clear, but the corrupted side hides most of them, so it can never be finished.
Have you ever seen the split screen?
first_comment: What is the best arcade game ever made?
